attempt_definition_review.condition: Only when the current access snapshot marks the package legally executable.
attempt_definition_review.implementation: When the access snapshot says a package is legally executable, _GameMeasurementCapture.observe_selected_action records an attempt if _action_commits_to_package returns true. For Malcolm/Glint-Horn, declaring Glint-Horn as an attacker counts, and otherwise a non-pass action whose public identity is one of the package pieces counts.
attempt_definition_review.legacy_seed_101_consequence: A Turn-10 Glint-Horn cast can satisfy the current implementation's package-commit predicate even though no Glint-Horn activation appears in that trace.
attempt_definition_review.written_definition: Phase C measurement authorities require first actual attempt reporting but do not define which concrete action starts an attempt.

broker_test.public_semantic_requirement: The discard object id is a private execution choice and must not be exposed in the public action key or public metadata. A repaired broker must bind an executable private discard choice while preserving public-information noninterference and exact replay.
broker_test.reason: No broker action existed to execute.
broker_test.source_mechanism: Battlefield activation enumeration supplies effect-choice variants. DRAW yields an empty choice mapping; no discard_ids are enumerated. The production executor probe therefore rejects the otherwise legal activation before it becomes an observed legal action.

classification_basis: Direct executor accepts the rule-legal activation with the explicit discard id; production broker omits that activation in the same public state; the broker-shaped empty choice mapping is rejected specifically because discard_ids is absent.
commit_semantics: The commit/tree identify the exact Stage-1 diagnostic source and test state. The later publication commit is intentionally not self-referential and is verified by GitHub read-back plus EVIDENCE_INDEX.json.

statement: Historical access figures were not rewritten or reclassified by Stage 1.

The production action surface could not expose at least one required Malcolm/Glint-Horn combo activation even though the executor supports that rules-legal activation when given the required discard choice.
Actual-attempt, never-attempted, package-attempt, combo-resolution, and terminal behavior may therefore be affected.
The population magnitude remains unmeasured; the two frozen seeds are not used to infer population magnitude.
Historical artifacts and percentages remain unchanged.
Stage 1 does not establish that every historical access-tracker witness was production-valid, so no separate access-overcount conclusion is asserted here.

The mechanism is structurally broader than this card: any battlefield activated ability requiring an explicit discard choice would use the same incomplete battlefield enumeration path unless separately handled.

standing_access_property: Every reported access result must contain or be reproducible as a finite production-valid witness sequence. The first witness action must be legal at the reported state, and each later witness action must become legal after executing the prior production action until the defined success condition is reached. A same-decision final-activation requirement is not adopted.
